title: Introduction to Film and Cinema
output: A film critique of one short or full length film.
content_standard: The learners understand film history, its genres, and the elements of film criticism, and recognize cinema's contribution to culture and society.
performance_standard: The learners produce a film review or critical essay on a commercial or short film.

title: Conceptualizing and Writing the Short Film
content_standard: The learners understand narrative structure and the ethics of fiction film writing, to produce narratives that reflect their vision and view of society and the human condition.
performance_standard: The learners produce a short screenplay built on storytelling, character development, and the technical skills to write for the screen.
